additional_info.subject: ID0397772-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001714] Display issue CRM:01410001355
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0397772 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
yes
End Customer Communication
yes
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
yes
Please arrange a site visit check the following:
1. Please check if the DPP cable in from controller to HMI is not loose, please also carry a spare DPP cable if the original DPP cable is having issues. (refer the attachment)
2. Check the 24V supply at the HMI panel, check if the value is deviating from 24V.
3. If the above steps are performed and the issue is still present, then perform a DLogic update as per the KA:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_DLogic update - Dynamics 365
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shreyas Sathe
